events.description: Directional drilling with PDC bit 10 5/8" + PD + HTTA MWD + RHINO REAMER 12 1/4" at depth from 5712m to 5719m (enlarging to 5691m). With WOB: 12-15 TON, 110-135 RPM, 14,000/16,500 FT-LB, 130 EPM, 500 GPM, 3900 PSI. NOTE1: Drilling meter 5717m, observed decrease in penetration time of 9 min per meter. Subsequently drilled meter by meter from 5717m to 5719m lifting string for safety, lifting free. Controlled torque parameters 17,000-19,000 FT-LB and WOB: 5 TON. NOTE2: Observed resistance to return to bottom from 5718.6 to 5719m with torque of 17,000-19,000 FT-LB. NOTE3: Decided to lift string to 5690m to recover bottom sample and characterize with geology.
Lifted string and bit 10 5/8" from 5,719 to 5,692m to circulate well and recover bottom sample and characterize by geology.

Directional drilling with PDC bit 10 5/8" + PD + HTTA MWD + RHINO REAMER 12 1/4" from 5,719m to 5752m (enlarging to 5724m). With WOB: 6-10 TON, 130 RPM, 14,000/16,500 FT-LB, 130 EPM, 500 GPM, 4000 PSI. BIT RECORD: 352m in 166:00 hrs. RHINO: 318m in 144:44 hrs. LAST 3 METERS: 36'-32'-44'. AVG: 32.78 MIN/M. NOTE: Increased mud density from 2.0 g/cc to 2.02 g/cc. NOTE1: Lifted with circulation and without rotation to 5,712m to verify weights, free. String weights: Static 206 TON, Up 222 TON, TQ off bottom 13,500 FT-LB. NOTE2: Suspended after obtaining 100 continuous drilling hours to make short trip according to program. NOTE3: Observed loss of HTTA MWD signal at 5752m. Performed anti-jamming test recovering tool signals (MWD) satisfactorily.
